The spezializations of the function
ara::log::ext::TraceArti
are generated
by the code generator of the trace tool vendor. These generated functions are
based on the configuration of the trace tool. The generated header file is named
trace_arti_spec.h
and is located where the header files of the modeled messeges
are located. Specializations of
ara::log::ext::TraceArti
are used to adapt the
API to the capabilities of the used trace tool. For example, the basic trace features of
the system like
LTTNG
can also serve as "trace tool".
Example message routing for minimal overhead can be achieved with the decorator
pattern and template specialization. Hereby the
ara::log::Logger
decorates the
LoggerImpl
